name: Vendor Return Authorization Workflow
problem: Warehouse staff create vendor returns by hand, and approvals are tracked in email.
solution: A return authorization form with automated approval routing and a nightly status sync.
impact: Fewer lost returns and faster vendor credits.
assumptions: Client will perform necessary testing to confirm the solution is working.
Any material changes to the scope estimated to exceed 8 hours of effort will require a formal change order for client approval.
Any material changes to the scope estimated at 8 hours or less of effort will be addressed under the existing ad-hoc support agreement.
Following deployment to production, the solution will be supported under this SOW for 5 business days. Thereafter, ongoing support will transition to the existing ad-hoc support agreement.
Effort estimates will be determined by Ethos in good faith based on initial review.
Client will provide the approver list before development starts.
